cohort: 136 obese pregnant women (BMI >= 30 kg/m2) in their first trimester, attending an antenatal outpatient department.
finding: Maternal obesity is associated with an increased incidence of gestational diabetes mellitus (14%), cesarean section (75%), and generally increased risks of adverse maternal, labor, and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Maternal obesity increases the incidence of cesarean section (75%) and the need for labor induction.
